title: CanonicalNode
description: One addressed object that survives every projection without losing identity. FOVEA owns STRUCTURE and PROJECTION; it does not own the source. A CanonicalNode is the only thing projections are allowed to consume.

id.description: Stable identity. THE identity glyph is derived from this and nothing else, so the same id is recognisable in every projection, forever.

label.description: Human-readable name. Presentation only — may change without affecting identity.

kind.description: What class of thing this is. Constrained to the six-face vocabulary so a node can be ADDRESSED without inventing field names.

source.description: Which adapter produced this node (code / readfield / material / audio ...). FOVEA must not care beyond this field.

address.description: Where this node sits, expressed in the six faces. PROJECTION reads these; it never invents its own.

B.description: RETURN — provenance, where it came from

R.description: OUTPUT — what may leave / transform / be reached

U.description: INTENTION — what governs it when presentation changes

D.description: GROUND — what is actually supported or unresolved

relations.description: Edges to other nodes. Used by FAN and by adjacency in LINE/RING. Never used to alter identity.

evidence.description: Face D. Anything claiming ground. A node with an empty evidence list is ALLOWED and must render as unresolved rather than as fact.

source.description: where this was checked; absent = unverified

overlays.description: LAW: identity determines the base glyph; interpretation modifies it ONLY as an overlay. Nothing in here may change the base shape — overlays may add a mark, an emphasis, an edge, never a different identity.

semantic.description: optional semantic class mark, e.g. noun / verb

age.description: ISO date; presentation may fade accordingly

focus.description: Face U at the interaction layer: the resolution budget. MOVED by Focus, never stored per-projection, so focus survives a projection switch.

$comment: INVARIANTS that projections must not violate:
1. id is immutable and is the sole input to the identity glyph.
2. Switching projection MUST NOT change id, address, relations, evidence or focus.
3. An overlay may decorate a node but must never change its base shape.
4. RETURN must restore the exact prior (projection, focusedId, address) tuple.
5. A node with error/absent fields renders as UNRESOLVED, not as a blank or a guess.
